**Why the model gave this decision**  
The model looks at a few key pieces of your credit profile. First, you have no balance on revolving credit (your utilization is 0 %). That fact alone pulls your risk down significantly. Second, you have no recent 30‑ to 59‑day past‑due accounts, which also lowers the chance of default. The only factor that nudges the risk upward is that you currently hold two real‑estate loans or mortgages. Having more mortgage debt adds a small amount of risk, but the overall picture is still “low risk,” with the model estimating a 17.4 % chance of default.
